name: Mohamed Hussein Mohamed
intro: I’m a Computer Science student, graphic designer and media professional with experience in technology, education and digital communication. I combine technical knowledge with creative thinking to build useful solutions and communicate ideas effectively.
university_so: Waxaan wax ka bartaa Kuala Lumpur University of Science and Technology (KLUST)

about.text: I’m Mohamed Hussein Mohamed, a Computer Science student at Kuala Lumpur University of Science and Technology, currently in Semester 5 of my Bachelor in Computer Science (Honours), focusing on data science, with a CGPA of 3.7. My interests cover data analytics, programming, graphic design, multimedia and digital communication.
about.text_so: Waxaan ahay Mohamed Hussein Mohamed, arday Kuala Lumpur University of Science and Technology ah, kuna jira simistarka 5 ee Bachelor in Computer Science (Honours), diiraddayduna waa data science; CGPA-gaygu waa 3.7. Waxaan xiiseeyaa falanqaynta xogta, barnaamijyada, naqshadaynta garaafik, warbaahinta iyo isgaarsiinta dijitaalka ah.

about.text: I have more than three years of graphic design experience and have worked as a graphic design lecturer, social media manager and cameraman. I currently support digital communication and creative work at Tech Grow Training and Innovation Center and Sahal Institute of Computer and Information Technology. At university, I serve as Social Media Officer for SSA-KLUST and serve as Head of Multimedia and Creativity for KLUST Cyber Alliance.
about.text_so: Waxaan leeyahay in ka badan saddex sano oo khibrad naqshadaynta garaafik ah, waxaanan ka shaqeeyey macallinnimo, maamulka baraha bulshada iyo sawir-qaadis. Hadda waxaan taageeraa shaqada hal-abuurka iyo isgaarsiinta ee Tech Grow iyo Sahal Institute. Jaamacadda waxaan ahay Sarkaalka Baraha Bulshada ee SSA-KLUST, waxaanan ahay Madaxa Warbaahinta Isku Dhafan iyo Hal-abuurka ee KLUST Cyber Alliance.

about.text: My technical skills include Python, Java, SQL, Power BI, Excel, HTML and CSS. I also use Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Canva, Figma and CapCut to create visual and multimedia content.
about.text_so: Xirfadahayga farsamo waxaa ka mid ah Python, Java, SQL, Power BI, Excel, HTML iyo CSS. Waxaan sidoo kale adeegsadaa Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Figma iyo CapCut si aan u sameeyo agab muuqaal iyo warbaahineed.

about.text: Through my academic projects and professional experience, I have developed strong communication, teamwork, leadership, critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. I enjoy learning, taking responsibility and using both creativity and technology to produce meaningful work.
about.text_so: Mashaariicdayda waxbarasho iyo khibraddayda shaqo waxay ii kobciyeen isgaarsiin, wada-shaqayn, hoggaamin, fikir gorfayn leh iyo xallinta dhibaatooyinka. Waxaan jeclahay barashada, masuuliyad qaadashada iyo adeegsiga hal-abuurka iyo tiknoolajiyada si aan u soo saaro shaqo qiimo leh.

university: Studying at Kuala Lumpur University of Science and Technology (KLUST)
intro_so: Waxaan ahay arday barta cilmiga kombiyuutarka, naqshadeeye garaafik iyo xirfadle warbaahineed oo khibrad u leh tiknoolajiyada, waxbarashada iyo isgaarsiinta dijitaalka ah. Waxaan isku daraa aqoon farsamo iyo fikir hal-abuur leh si aan u dhiso xalal waxtar leh, fikradahana si hufan u gudbiyo.
